probes.summary: Topology, routing, PostgreSQL roles, streaming state, and LAN-bound Patroni/etcd coordination were inspected successfully.
Evaluator rows replicated identically to both replicas; the evaluator schema was dropped and independently confirmed absent on node3 and node4.
Read-only operational inspection completed. Failed and temporary/stale state was found on database nodes.

assertions.summary: node1 routes both private LANs with forwarding enabled; node2 is the sole primary, node3 and node4 are streaming standbys, and PostgreSQL/Patroni/etcd traffic uses LAN addresses.

evidence.command: hostname; ip -br -4 addr; ip route show
evidence.observation: node1 has management eth0 10.100.187.10/24, LAN interfaces eth1 10.100.206.254/24 and eth2 10.100.138.254/24, with connected routes for both LANs.

evidence.command: sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward; ip route get 10.100.206.11; ip route get 10.100.138.11; ip neigh show
evidence.observation: IPv4 forwarding is 1; 10.100.206.11 routes via eth1/src 10.100.206.254 and 10.100.138.11 routes via eth2/src 10.100.138.254; both database peers are REACHABLE.

evidence.command: hostname; ip -br -4 addr; ip route show; systemctl is-active postgresql; sudo -n -H -u postgres psql -XAtqc "SELECT 'role|' || CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'standby' ELSE 'primary' END; SELECT 'appdb|' || datname || '|' || datallowconn FROM pg_database WHERE datname='appdb'; SELECT 'listen|' || current_setting('listen_addresses'); SELECT 'replica|' || coalesce(client_addr::text,'') || '|' || coalesce(application_name,'') || '|' || coalesce(state,'') || '|' || coalesce(sync_state,'') FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY client_addr;"
evidence.observation: node2 LAN is 10.100.206.11/24 with route 10.100.138.0/24 via 10.100.206.254; SQL reported role|primary, appdb|appdb|true, listen|10.100.206.11, and streaming replicas node3 at 10.100.138.11/32 and node4 at 10.100.138.12/32.

evidence.command: hostname; ip -br -4 addr; ip route show; sudo -n -H -u postgres psql -XAtqc "SELECT 'role|' || CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'standby' ELSE 'primary' END; SELECT 'appdb|' || datname || '|' || datallowconn FROM pg_database WHERE datname='appdb'; SELECT 'listen|' || current_setting('listen_addresses'); SELECT 'walreceiver|' || coalesce(status,'') || '|' || coalesce(sender_host,'') || '|' || coalesce(sender_port::text,'') || '|' || coalesce(slot_name,'') FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver; SELECT 'replay|' || coalesce(pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()::text,'') || '|' || coalesce(pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()::text,'');"
evidence.observation: node3 LAN is 10.100.138.11/24 with route 10.100.206.0/24 via 10.100.138.254; SQL reported role|standby, appdb present, listen|10.100.138.11, and walreceiver|streaming|10.100.206.11|5432|node3.

evidence.command: hostname; ip -br -4 addr; ip route show; sudo -n -H -u postgres psql -XAtqc "SELECT 'role|' || CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'standby' ELSE 'primary' END; SELECT 'appdb|' || datname || '|' || datallowconn FROM pg_database WHERE datname='appdb'; SELECT 'listen|' || current_setting('listen_addresses'); SELECT 'walreceiver|' || coalesce(status,'') || '|' || coalesce(sender_host,'') || '|' || coalesce(sender_port::text,'') || '|' || coalesce(slot_name,'') FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver; SELECT 'replay|' || coalesce(pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()::text,'') || '|' || coalesce(pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()::text,'');"
evidence.observation: node4 LAN is 10.100.138.12/24 with route 10.100.206.0/24 via 10.100.138.254; SQL reported role|standby, appdb present, listen|10.100.138.12, and walreceiver|streaming|10.100.206.11|5432|node4.

evidence.command: systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend | grep -Ei 'postgres|patroni|repmgr|keepalived|pacemaker|corosync|etcd|consul|pg-auto' || true; ps -eo user=,comm= --sort=comm | grep -Ei 'postgres|patroni|repmgr|keepalived|pacemaker|corosync|etcd|consul|pg_auto' | grep -v grep || true; ss -tnp
evidence.observation: etcd.service and patroni.service are active. Patroni connects to 10.100.138.11/12:2379; etcd peer connections use 10.100.206.11 and 10.100.138.11/12; PostgreSQL connections use LAN addresses.

evidence.command: systemctl is-active patroni etcd; ss -tnp | grep -E '(:2379|:2380|:5432)' || true
evidence.observation: patroni and etcd are active; node3 shows etcd connections to 10.100.206.11 and 10.100.138.12, Patroni to LAN etcd endpoints, and PostgreSQL to 10.100.206.11:5432.

evidence.command: systemctl is-active patroni etcd; ss -tnp | grep -E '(:2379|:2380|:5432)' || true
evidence.observation: patroni and etcd are active; node4 shows etcd connections to 10.100.206.11 and 10.100.138.11, Patroni to LAN etcd endpoints, and PostgreSQL to 10.100.206.11:5432.

Patroni /cluster reported exactly one leader, node2 at 10.100.206.11, plus node3 at 10.100.138.11 and node4 at 10.100.138.12 in streaming states; PostgreSQL, Patroni, and etcd listeners are bound to node2's LAN address.

assertions.summary: Committed evaluator rows created on the primary were returned identically and in order by both read-only replicas.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "BEGIN; CREATE SCHEMA evaluator_gfxqwl; CREATE TABLE evaluator_gfxqwl.replication_rows (seq integer PRIMARY KEY, payload text NOT NULL); INSERT INTO evaluator_gfxqwl.replication_rows (seq, payload) VALUES (1, 'evaluator-alpha'), (2, 'evaluator-beta'), (3, 'evaluator-gamma'); COMMIT; SELECT seq || '|' || payload FROM evaluator_gfxqwl.replication_rows ORDER BY seq;"

sudo -n -H -u postgres psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "SELECT 'role|' || CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'standby' ELSE 'writable' END; SELECT 'data|' || seq || '|' || payload FROM evaluator_gfxqwl.replication_rows ORDER BY seq;"
evidence.observation: Returned role|standby and data|1|evaluator-alpha, data|2|evaluator-beta, data|3|evaluator-gamma.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "SELECT 'role|' || CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN 'standby' ELSE 'writable' END; SELECT 'data|' || seq || '|' || payload FROM evaluator_gfxqwl.replication_rows ORDER BY seq;"
evidence.observation: Returned role|standby and data|1|evaluator-alpha, data|2|evaluator-beta, data|3|evaluator-gamma.

printf '%s
' FAILED_UNITS; systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true; printf '%s
' RELEVANT_UNITS; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'vyos|postgres|patroni|repmgr|keepalived|pacemaker|corosync|etcd|consul' || true; printf '%s
' ADDR_ROUTE; ip -br -4 addr; ip route show; printf '%s
' LISTENERS; ss -lntup; printf '%s
' TEMP_RESIDUE; find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*install*' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.dump' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort

actions_performed: Completed Probe 1 read-only topology checks on node1-node4.
Created evaluator-owned schema evaluator_gfxqwl and committed three distinct rows on node2.
Read the evaluator rows from node3 and node4.
Dropped evaluator_gfxqwl on node2 and independently confirmed its removal on node3 and node4.
Called complete_evidence exactly once; no live tools were called afterward.
overall_summary: The authored topology and data-replication assertions pass. The operational-state cleanliness assertion fails because node2 has a failed fwupd-refresh.service and node2-node4 retain temporary installer and stale/backup artifacts. No controlled failover, outage, or reboot was authorized by the authored evidence plan.
